court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
judges: And By Considering The Inconvenience J.
trial_court: Family Court, Pudukottai (HMOP No. 27 of 2022) and Additional Family Court, Coimbatore (HMOP No. 1928 of 2021)
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2020. The wife filed HMOP for restitution of conjugal rights, while the husband filed HMOP for dissolution of marriage. Both cases are pending before different courts.

legal_principles.principle: The intention of the parties in filing matrimonial cases is irrelevant for considering transfer applications.
legal_principles.held: Intention of the parties in filing the matrimonial cases are irrelevant for the purpose of considering the transfer application filed to transfer cases from one court to another court.

legal_principles.principle: Courts are not expected to get carried away with emotions or societal implications in matrimonial cases.
legal_principles.held: Courts are not expected to get carried away with such emotions or otherwise.

legal_principles.principle: The place of residence of the wife is preferable for conducting the trial in matrimonial cases.
legal_principles.held: As far as the present transfer petition is concerned, the place of residence of the wife is preferable for conducting the trial, in view of the amendment in Hindu Marriage Act and also based on the principles laid down by the Courts.

legal_principles.principle: The domicile or citizenship of the opposite party is immaterial in matrimonial cases.
legal_principles.held: The domicile or citizenship of the opposite party is immaterial in a case like this.

outcome.final_order: The court transferred the case from Family Court, Pudukottai to Additional Family Court, Coimbatore.

use_for_drafting: advising on restitution of conjugal rights
